messages.text: Friday, November 27 · Canton, Michigan
Drizzle over the pavement and a quiet shift in local zoning

A damp, overcast Thursday settles over Canton as we navigate the complexities of regional infrastructure. We look toward the intersection of data center expansion and our community's environmental future.
Expect heavy drizzle throughout the day with a high near 42 degrees and a low around 35 degrees.
The sun rises at 7:39 AM and sets at 5:04 PM, with the moon currently in a waning gibbous phase at 89.9 percent illumination.
Quiet rhythms for a gray Thursday
With no local events scheduled for today, it is a suitable time to enjoy the stillness or prepare for tomorrow's regional offerings.
Looking ahead, the Kelsey Museum of Archaeology in Ann Arbor hosts a Saturday Sampler Tour exploring ancient collections at 2 PM on November 28.
Data center growth and permit oversight

Wayne County has issued a stop-work order for the Project Cannoli data center in Van Buren Township due to missing construction permits. This development arrives as researchers note that such projects complicate Michigan's 2035 renewable energy targets.
Looking toward the weekend
Consider the Saturday Sampler Tour at the Kelsey Museum of Archaeology on November 28 at 2 PM, or keep the December 3 performance of Last Call Improv in Hamtramck on your radar.

Saturday, November 28 · Canton, Michigan
Ancient cat mummies and boogie-woogie piano in the autumn drizzle

The day brings a gentle, overcast dampness to Canton as we navigate the transition toward December. Local interest centers on a look at ancient artifacts in Ann Arbor, while research into the impact of data centers on our regional energy future continues to evolve.
Expect light drizzle throughout the day with temperatures reaching a high of 46 degrees and dropping to a low of 33 degrees.
Sunrise is at 7:40 AM and sunset at 5:03 PM, with the moon currently in a waning gibbous phase at 81.7 percent illumination.
A day for history and rhythm
The Kelsey Museum of Archaeology offers a free sampler tour of their ancient collections at 2:00 PM. Later, pianist Mr. B performs his annual concert at The Ark at 8:00 PM.
The local calendar turns toward committee work early next week, with both the 862 and RPM meetings scheduled for the evening of December 2.
Data centers and our energy future

Recent research highlights that the expansion of data centers in nearby Saline and Van Buren Townships poses complex challenges to meeting Michigan's 2035 renewable energy goals. While these facilities may provide funding for new green energy projects, their substantial power requirements remain a point of significant scrutiny.
Looking toward the week ahead
Prepare for a rainy Saturday and keep the upcoming Tuesday evening meetings in mind for local civic engagement.
